B2 职场英语 ~50 sec

Cross-team Follow-up

100Ls Shadowing Material · M3-06 · EP19  ·  职场英语：跨部门推进  ·  8/30–9/5
📄 Full Script — Dialogue
0:00 / 0:00
速度：
Jordan
Hey Alex, glad we could find time. I wanted to follow up on the integration work we discussed last sprint.
Alex
Right, good timing. To be honest, we've had some capacity issues. Two engineers are still tied up with the current release.
Jordan
I get that. Would it help if we adjusted the scope slightly? We could start with just the core API endpoints and defer the edge cases.
Alex
That actually makes things much more manageable. When are you expecting to lock down the specs?
Jordan
We can finalize them by end of this week. I'll loop in the PM to confirm the prioritization as well.
Alex
Perfect. One more thing — can we get a dedicated Slack channel? It'll be easier to track blockers in real time.
Jordan
Absolutely. I'll set it up today and tag both teams. Should we do a quick sync every Monday to stay aligned?
Alex
That works for me. Consistent check-ins will help us catch issues early.
Jordan
Agreed. Let's make it happen.
Jordan：嘿 Alex，很高兴我们能找到时间。我想跟进一下上个冲刺讨论过的集成工作。
Alex：好的，时机正好。说实话，我们遇到了一些产能问题。有两名工程师还在忙当前版本的发布。
Jordan：我理解。如果我们稍微缩小一下范围，会有帮助吗？我们可以先从核心 API 端点开始，把边界情况先搁置。
Alex：这样实际上会好推进很多。你们预计什么时候能锁定规格说明？
Jordan：我们可以在本周末前敲定。我也会把 PM 拉进来，确认优先级排序。
Alex：好的。还有一件事——我们能建一个专用的 Slack 频道吗？这样实时追踪卡点会更方便。
Jordan：当然。我今天就建好，并 @ 两个团队。我们每周一做个简短同步，保持对齐，怎么样？
Alex：我没问题。定期 check-in 能帮我们更早发现问题。
Jordan：同意。那我们就这么推进吧。
今天听了 0 遍

follow up
/ˈfɒloʊ ʌp/
phrasal verb
跟进；后续跟踪
🔗 常见搭配
follow up on sthfollow-up meetingsend a follow-up
💬 例句
I wanted to follow up on our conversation from last week.
我想跟进一下我们上周的谈话。
Can you send a follow-up email after the meeting?
会后你能发一封跟进邮件吗？

🔗 Connected Speech
glad we
/ɡlæd wi/ — consonant-to-vowel linking + /d/ → /w/ glide
Consonant-Vowel Linking
"glad" 末尾辅音 /d/ 直接连入 "we" 的 /w/，听起来像 "gladwe"，无停顿。类似：good enough → /ɡʊd ɪˈnʌf/，find it → /faɪn dɪt/
tied up
/taɪd ʌp/ — consonant-vowel linking
Consonant-Vowel Linking
"tied" 末尾 /d/ 直接滑入 "up" 的元音 /ʌ/，连读成 "tiedup"。类似：picked up → /pɪkt ʌp/，held on → /hɛld ɒn/
end of
/ɛnd əv/ — vowel-to-vowel linking + weak form
Weak Form + Linking
"of" 弱读为 /əv/，"end" 的 /d/ 连入 /ə/，整体流畅连读。类似：kind of → /kaɪnd əv/，top of → /tɒp əv/
set it up
/sɛt ɪt ʌp/ — consonant-vowel chaining
Chained Consonant-Vowel Linking
三个单词连续链接：/t/ 连 /ɪ/，再 /t/ 连 /ʌ/，听起来像一个流畅单位 "setitup"。类似：pick it up → /pɪk ɪt ʌp/，take it on → /teɪk ɪt ɒn/
let's make
/lɛts meɪk/ — /ts/+/m/ cluster smoothing
Stop Cluster Smoothing
/ts/ 后接 /m/ 时快速连读，"let's" 的 /ts/ 轻微削弱，无明显停顿。类似：what's more → /wɒts mɔːr/，that's me → /ðæts miː/
catch issues
/kætʃ ˈɪʃuːz/ — consonant-vowel linking + /tʃ/ flow
Affricate-Vowel Linking
送气音 /tʃ/ 直接接 "issues" 的 /ɪ/，自然流入，不分割。类似：reach out → /riːtʃ aʊt/，teach others → /tiːtʃ ˈʌðərz/
